internet_issue.title: Internet Connection Problem
steps: Check whether your router and modem are powered on and all status lights look normal.
Restart the router and modem by unplugging them for 30 seconds, then plug them back in.
Make sure Wi-Fi is enabled on your device and reconnect to the correct network.
Test another website or app to confirm whether the issue is with the internet or one specific service.
Move closer to the router or remove obstacles that may weaken the wireless signal.
If the issue continues on all devices, contact your internet service provider.

login_issue.title: Login or Password Problem
steps: Confirm that the username or email address is typed correctly.
Check that Caps Lock is off and re-enter the password carefully.
Use the password reset option if you cannot remember your credentials.
Clear browser cache and cookies if the login page keeps rejecting valid credentials.
Try logging in from another browser or device to rule out a browser-specific issue.
If your account is locked, contact the administrator or support team.

slow_system.title: Slow Computer or System Performance
steps: Close unnecessary apps and browser tabs that may be consuming memory or CPU.
Restart the system to clear temporary processes and free up resources.
Check available disk space and remove unused files if storage is almost full.
Run a malware or antivirus scan to detect harmful software affecting performance.
Install pending system and driver updates.
If the system remains slow, review startup apps and disable non-essential ones.

printer_issue.title: Printer Not Working
steps: Make sure the printer is powered on and connected to the computer or network.
Check for paper jams, low ink, or toner warnings on the printer display.
Set the correct printer as the default printer in system settings.
Cancel any stuck print jobs and try printing a test page.
Restart both the printer and the computer.
Reinstall or update the printer driver if printing still fails.

email_issue.title: Email Sending or Receiving Problem
steps: Verify that your internet connection is working properly.
Check that the email address and password configured in the mail app are correct.
Review the spam, junk, or quarantine folders for missing messages.
Confirm that your mailbox is not full and has enough storage available.
Sign out and sign back into the email application.
If the issue persists, verify the incoming and outgoing mail server settings.

audio_issue.title: Sound or Audio Problem
steps: Make sure the device volume is turned up and not muted.
Check whether the correct speaker or headset is selected as the output device.
Reconnect headphones, speakers, or Bluetooth audio devices if applicable.
Restart the audio application and test sound in another app.
Update or reinstall the audio driver from device settings.
Restart the computer if audio still does not work.

display_issue.title: Screen or Display Problem
steps: Check that the monitor is powered on and connected securely.
Adjust the brightness settings to ensure the screen is not dimmed.
Reconnect or replace the HDMI, DisplayPort, or VGA cable.
Press the monitor input/source button and select the correct input.
Restart the computer and test with an external display if available.
Update the graphics driver if the display flickers or remains blank.

battery_issue.title: Battery or Charging Problem
steps: Confirm that the charging cable and power adapter are connected firmly.
Try a different wall outlet or charger if one is available.
Inspect the charging port for dust or visible damage.
Restart the device and check whether charging resumes.
Reduce heavy background usage that may drain the battery faster than it charges.
If the battery still does not charge or drains quickly, consider battery health diagnostics or replacement.

bluetooth_issue.title: Bluetooth Connection Problem
steps: Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on both devices.
Place the devices close together and remove any major interference sources.
Forget the Bluetooth device and pair it again.
Check whether the accessory is already connected to another device.
Restart Bluetooth on your device or reboot both devices.
Update the Bluetooth driver or system software if pairing continues to fail.

update_issue.title: Software Update Problem
steps: Check that the device has a stable internet connection.
Ensure there is enough free storage space to download and install updates.
Restart the device and try the update again.
Temporarily disable VPN or proxy settings that may interrupt update servers.
Review the update error code in system settings for more specific guidance.
If the update still fails, download the update manually from the official vendor site if available.

storage_issue.title: Low Storage Problem
steps: Delete unnecessary files such as large downloads, videos, or duplicate documents.
Empty the recycle bin or trash folder to reclaim space.
Uninstall applications you no longer use.
Move large files to cloud storage or an external drive.
Clear temporary files and browser cache.
Restart the device and confirm available storage has increased.

browser_issue.title: Browser Not Working Properly
steps: Refresh the page and test whether the issue happens on multiple websites.
Clear browser cache and cookies.
Disable extensions one by one to find out whether an add-on is causing the problem.
Update the browser to the latest version.
Try opening the site in incognito mode or a different browser.
Restart the browser or reinstall it if crashes continue.

vpn_issue.title: VPN Connection Problem
steps: Confirm that your internet connection works without the VPN.
Verify your VPN username, password, and server address.
Disconnect and reconnect to the VPN service.
Try a different VPN server location if one is available.
Restart the VPN application and your device.
If the VPN still fails, contact your network administrator for server-side checks.

security_alert.title: Security Warning or Suspicious Activity
steps: Disconnect from the internet if you suspect active malicious behavior.
Run a full antivirus or endpoint protection scan immediately.
Change passwords for important accounts from a trusted device.
Review recent login history or unusual account activity.
Install all pending security and operating system updates.
Report the incident to your IT or security team if this is a work device.

app_crash.title: Application Crash or Freeze
steps: Close and reopen the application.
Restart the device to clear temporary conflicts.
Check for updates for the application and install the latest version.
Make sure the system meets the app's minimum requirements and has enough free memory.
Reset the app settings or reinstall the application if the crashes continue.
Review any error messages or logs for a more specific failure clue.

webcam_issue.title: Webcam Not Working
steps: Make sure no other application is currently using the camera.
Check the camera privacy settings and allow access for the affected app.
Reconnect the external webcam or restart the laptop camera service.
Test the webcam in another app to confirm whether the issue is app-specific.
Update or reinstall the camera driver.
Restart the device if the camera feed remains blank.

keyboard_issue.title: Keyboard Not Responding
steps: Reconnect the keyboard or replace the batteries if it is wireless.
Test another USB port or Bluetooth pairing if the keyboard is external.
Restart the computer to reset input services.
Check whether Filter Keys or similar accessibility settings are interfering.
Update or reinstall the keyboard driver from device settings.
If only specific keys fail, clean the keyboard and check for physical damage.

network_drive_issue.title: Network Drive Access Problem
steps: Confirm that you are connected to the correct office or VPN network.
Check that the shared drive path is correct and still available.
Try disconnecting and reconnecting the mapped network drive.
Verify that your account still has permission to access the shared folder.
Restart File Explorer or the computer if the drive appears offline.
Contact the server or IT administrator if the share is unavailable for multiple users.
